com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Public; no sign-in required. Pricing reads require store:prices:write, listing.draft.update requires store:listings:drafts:write, inventory.adjust requires store:inventory:write, and listing.draft.submit requires store:listings:drafts:submit. Each rechecks live consent, approved store ownership and EDIT_LISTINGS permission. Records remain isolated by actor, store, grant, environment and action.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Reads durable activity and local results without resuming execution. An explicit pricing reconcile_channel may perform the documented read-only provider probe.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Foreign, revoked or expired grants and stale versions fail. Unapproved plans require web review. Idempotency-key reuse for another plan conflicts; a lost response is recovered through supercatch_find_operations or supercatch_get_operation before any new action.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: No inventory, order, automation settings or listing publication changes. Local completion does not establish marketplace prices.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Recover one exact pricing operation and its committed local prices/versions. Optional reconcile_channel performs one live read of a frozen target on this result page. Supports individual eBay fixed-price offers; compares explicit USD against current channel adjustments, separately from local completion. Other providers, auctions, discounts and shared offers remain unavailable. Never submits or repairs prices.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns a concrete pricing, listing.draft.update , inventory.adjust or listing.draft.submit operation/history envelope selected by the read action. Inventory receipts confirm local stock/history only, not provider inventory.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Recover or inspect an operation without resuming execution. Omit action for legacy pricing; set action to listing.draft.update for saved photo drafts , inventory.adjust for native stock corrections, or listing.draft.submit for frozen internal review submissions.
